name: ate_market_get
description: Market state per market (or both if market is omitted): pool spot and 300 s TWAP, APRO oracle snapshot and age, HashKey Global CEX reference (mid, half-spread, top-of-book depth, recent trades), pool-vs-oracle deviation, depth, and the vault's balances, epoch budget and limits. Prices are 8-decimal integer strings (USD per whole token).
